column2: Your plane lands at Gimhae International Airport, on the edge of Busan. The mountains and the Nakdong River of Korea's second city greet you.
At immigration the officer asks for your documents. What do you show?
My passport and entry approval (K-ETA/visa if needed)
Correct. Keep them handy until you are through customs.
A boarding pass is not an ID. Immigration needs your passport.
It's late summer. Your airline app warns that flights are cancelled when typhoons reach the south coast – this happens in August–September.
Global ATM in the arrivals hall
Before leaving the airport: how do you keep your hotel's address handy?
You take the Busan–Gimhae Light Rail to Sasang, then the subway – T-money cards work in Busan too. Change to Line 1 (orange) at Seomyeon for Jagalchi.
